caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden-framed wall clock with two distinct sections. The upper section contains the clock face, which is circular with a cream background and black Roman numerals marking the hours, as well as two black hands. The clock face is partly transparent, revealing some internal golden gears and mechanical components as well as a floral pattern in the corners of the clock face panel. The lower section displays a painted scene featuring a landscape with a two-story white house with red accents and windows, surrounded by green grass, small shrubs, and trees. A prominent willow tree with drooping green foliage stands in the center of the scene, and a small body of blue water is visible at the bottom of the painted panel. The entire clock is set against a plain off-white or beige background, and the artist's name “John Koehl” is faintly inscribed near the bottom right of the image.
title: Painted Clock
